name: razgon-2d-studio
description: Voiceover → cinematic stick-figure video with motivated camera paths, weight and impacts, motion blur, designed transitions (whip, push, iris, match, smash), kinetic typography and SFX synced to visual events. Code-rendered 2D + 3D, Whisper timestamps, five styles, 16:9 or 9:16 up to 4K. Runs on Android/Termux too: the renderer falls back to a system Chromium, and `termux/studio.sh` sets the whole studio up on a phone.
